% note: Per-shape numbers are descriptive: the tests are the pooled ones in ⟦TAB-10⟧. A chain is one puzzle whose answer carries all the steps; pieces are separate one-step puzzles.
% note: The B2 challenger is the vote of $k$ Haiku-max samples, $k$~=~6; B1 and B3 use one Haiku-max sample. Intervals are cluster bootstrap over puzzles (accuracies) and paired bootstrap ($d$).
% note: For Test~B2 the challenger's format compliance is that of the single Haiku-max samples the vote is taken over.
% note: The per-test intervals here and ⟦TAB-12⟧'s intervals for the same setting and shape (for the B2 vote, ⟦FIG-03⟧'s) come from separate bootstrap draws over the same puzzles, with the same points, and differ only by resampling, so their ends can differ slightly; where both collapsed to one value, both show the same exact interval.
% note: ``(exact, post hoc; \ldots{} puzzles)'' marks a bootstrap interval that collapsed to one value (every puzzle right, or every one wrong), replaced by the exact two-sided 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval from free analysis 4 (post hoc; it changes no test). The count in the mark is the number of puzzles, not of samples (the conservative unit).
% note: Panel~1 gives the pooled tests in the three views; its readings are per view, and a test holds only if it is no worse in all three views (⟦TAB-10⟧). The three views agree to every printed digit because no refusal or truncation touched either side of a test.
% note: Panel~1's ties-counted-wrong row for Test~B2 is post hoc (free analysis 13): the vote is scored as deployed, except that a vote whose top answers tie, the right one among them, scores nothing instead of an equal share; $d$ and its paired bootstrap interval only, with no $p$ and no reading, and B2's reading is unchanged. A tie that included the right answer decided 1.32\% of B2's 6-sample votes (a mean over puzzles, each over all of its possible votes; three-against-three ties alone 1.15\%); such a tie decided at least one vote in 11 of the 80 puzzles (in either shape). ⟦TAB-02⟧ gives the tie-decided share for Tests~1--3.
